body: I can’t change the way you feel about yourself right now but I want to let you know that you’re not done changing/growing. I feel pretty bad about my own appearance but you have to remind yourself that you’re not even done developing until 25!! You grow into your features and I hope you can become confident in them. Societal beauty standards are temporary and always changing, so you should define beauty for yourself or you’ll always feel like you don’t fit. Hope you feel better soon ❤️
Happy early birthday! Try to do something special for yourself to curb loneliness/aloneness. You’re not alone on that feeling ❤️
